about: One-sided changes in httpx at b5addb6, read by hand. 'pair' is every one-sided change to the two _send_single_request copies; 'sample' is 20 partial clone-group changes drawn by sample.py (random.seed(2547)) from the 73 that cochange.py finds. Classes: out_of_step (one copy changed and the other needed it too, or the change brought one copy back in line with the other); on_purpose (the change belongs to one copy, or one family of copies, by design); cosmetic (a typo, a docstring, formatting: no behaviour changed); miscounted (both copies did change; the line tracing lost one).

pair.note: black 20 dropped a trailing comma in the async signature; the sync signature had none to drop
the fix for a copy slip: the async copy had been testing hasattr(stream, "close"), the sync copy's test, before awaiting stream.aclose(); this commit made it test "aclose"
a trailing comma in a tuple, removed in the async copy only
map_exceptions around the async stream close; the sync close never got it, and the Transport API rewrite (1a6e254, five weeks later) replaced both
#2547: request logging to INFO in the sync copy only
#2656: the same change in the async copy, 23 days later
a typo in an error message only the async copy has

sample.note: Headers.values and Headers.items both changed to decode with self.encoding; the trace of items does not reach back this far
multipart: delete() then took a request body, like post(), and changed with that family
delete() loses its body parameters and joins get/head/options
the module-level functions switch from AsyncClient to the reintroduced sync Client
Client.__init__ gains the http2 parameter AsyncClient.__init__ already had
the async docstring's example lacked an await: the sync docstring, copied
proxies added to the module-level functions; a client takes it in its constructor
a docstring for httpx.stream()
USE_CLIENT_DEFAULT, a client-only idea, in the client methods
an extensions parameter for the client methods, which the module-level functions do not take
typos in a docstring only Headers.items has
AsyncClient.__init__'s default_encoding annotation widened to match Client.__init__'s
a type for the client methods' extensions parameter
#2845: proxy_ssl_context passed in HTTPTransport only; AsyncHTTPTransport got it in 88a81c5 (#3175), eight months later
TextChunker.decode stops returning an empty chunk; ByteChunker.decode had had the same fix since 420911b (#2068), 22 months earlier
#3023 'Add missing argument': http1 passed in AsyncClient._init_proxy_transport, as Client's already did
#3120 'Keep clients in sync': Client.get's auth annotation brought in line with the other methods
verify reworked on the module-level functions; a client takes it in its constructor
verify's type widened on the module-level functions only, for the same reason
a typo in an error message only aiter_raw has
